messages:
fiona: quick flag  noticed a sustained uptick in 409/version-mismatch errors after the default flip. A few tenants' clients keep retrying. thoughts on a gentler fallback to reduce quota pressure?
mike: share an example?
fiona: pattern: 
```
req: POST /v1/chat  x-client-version: v1
res: 409 {\"error\":\"version-mismatch\",\"served\":\"v2\"}
```
rana: classic. Non-2xx -> client libs assume transient. they hammer.
clare: operationally i'd prefer a two-mode approach: quarantine-strict (409 + tag) and quarantine-soft (200 + compat wrapper + header). soft only for tenants that trip retry thresholds.
mike: agree. soft-mode should still surface a deprecation header: `x-compat-warning: migrate-to=v2` so it's explicit.
deploy-bot: rollout: v2-default enabled in region-us-west at 03:12 UTC. canary ok.
fiona: telemetry req: emit `compat.mode` tag (values: strict|soft) and `compat.retry_rate` per-route, per-tenant. Rana can use that to trigger autopilot.
rana: plan: if `compat.retry_rate` > 0.8 req/s for 4m -> flip tenant to soft-mode for 30m and notify tenant. Provide manual console override.
clare: console UX: yellow banner + CTA 'simulate v2'. simulate should proxy a single sample request to v2 and show side-by-side diff. log simulate action as an audit event.
mike: we must not change billing. Soft responses billed normally and flagged `compat.soft=true` in logs.
fiona: banner copy draft: "Using an older client (v1). Compatibility mode applied to reduce retries. Migrate to v2 -> docs.redwood/migrate"
rana: also add short-lived metrics: `compat.retry_burst` and `compat.quarantine_count`. Helps detect exponential retries.
clare: ops runbook steps: 1) detect via `compat.retry_rate`, 2) autopilot soft-mode, 3) if soft-mode doesn't reduce retries in 20m -> escalate P1 and consider roll-back. include console command: `toggle_compat(tenant, mode)`
mike: i'll add infra ticket for tags and headers. Include example: `metric: compat.retry_rate{tenant=acme,route=/v1/chat} 1.2`
fiona: outreach: compile tenants with >100 v1 requests last 24h and send targeted docs + migration office hours.
rana: timeline: infra + metrics today, console banner + simulate tomorrow AM, autopilot in 6hrs after metrics land.
fiona: perfect. check-in in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
